import primitive_api as api
import json

ctx = api.get_task_context()
obs = api.observe_world()
acc = api.list_accessible_objects()
nearby = api.list_nearby_objects()
inv = api.list_inventory()
tele = api.list_teleport_locations()

print("CTX:", json.dumps(ctx, indent=2))
print("OBS keys:", list(obs.keys()))
print("OBS:", json.dumps(obs, indent=2))
print("ACCESSIBLE:", json.dumps(acc, indent=2))
print("NEARBY:", json.dumps(nearby, indent=2))
print("INVENTORY:", json.dumps(inv, indent=2))
print("TELEPORT:", json.dumps(tele, indent=2))

steps.code:
import primitive_api as api
import json

# Record evidence from Discovery Feed
api.write_evidence("target_author", "Wanda")
api.write_evidence("wanda_instruction", "Please pick up the rock (glowing) and place it in the pot.")

# Let's move north and see where the glowing rock (uuid: 51021) and pot (uuid: 5035) are relative to us.
# Currently at (18, 12) facing south.
# Pot is north at distance 2 (so probably at (18, 10)).
# Rock (glowing) is north-west at distance 3.
res1 = api.move_direction("north")
obs = api.observe_world()
print("Location after north:", obs["agentLocation"])
print("Accessible:", api.list_accessible_objects())
print("Nearby rock/pot:", api.list_nearby_objects(query="rock"), api.list_nearby_objects(query="pot"))

steps.code:
import primitive_api as api

# Move west to (17, 11), where rock (glowing) [uuid: 51021] is 1 tile west (at (16, 11))
api.move_direction("west")
print("Accessible at (17, 11):", api.list_accessible_objects())

# Pick up the glowing rock
val_pickup = api.validate_action_call("pickup_object", obj=51021)
print("Validate pickup:", val_pickup)
if val_pickup.get("ok"):
    res_pickup = api.pickup_object(51021)
    print("Pickup result:", res_pickup)

# Move east back to (18, 11) and rotate north to face the pot [uuid: 5035]
api.move_direction("east")
api.rotate_direction("north")
print("Accessible at (18, 11) facing north:", api.list_accessible_objects())
print("Inventory:", api.list_inventory())

# Put glowing rock into the pot
val_put = api.validate_action_call("put_object", obj=51021, target=5035)
print("Validate put:", val_put)
if val_put.get("ok"):
    res_put = api.put_object(51021, 5035)
    print("Put result:", res_put)

print("Check success:", api.check_success())
